description: Check if a company can receive e-invoices over Peppol. Send a Peppol ID (0208:0403170701), an EU VAT number (BE0403170701, DE811569869) or a company name, up to 25 per call. Returns each registered participant from the official Peppol Directory: Peppol ID, scheme, company name, country, registration date, the document types in plain words (BIS Billing 3.0 Invoice, XRechnung 3.0, Order), whether it receives invoices, and the ready UBL cbc:EndpointID line. VAT numbers are matched to the exact participant, wrong formats are named. No contact data is returned. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/peppol-id-check.

country.description: ISO country code (BE, DE, NL ...): for names, and for numbers sent without a country code

queries.description: Up to 25 entries: Peppol IDs (scheme:value), VAT numbers with country code, or company names

name: peppol_id_check
